title: The impact of the US stock market opening on price discovery of government bond futures
about: Studies how the US equity opening affects bond-futures price discovery.
findings: Authors report greater information efficiency/permanent price impact after the opening using2010–17 US, German and UK contracts. This is not a verified later-return forecast.
mechanism: Equity information may improve contemporaneous bond pricing; no executable signed edge established.
build_on: Retain the distinction between price discovery and forecasting. No new return test justified.
can_strategy_code_be_made: Not a specified directional strategy; full rules and genuinely predictive evidence would be needed.
owned_input_mapping: ZN overlaps one target; foreign bond contracts and matching cross-market information are not supplied by owned ZN bars.
